Cloudinary Media CDN

SMTP Mail Relay

Invoices, Receipts, Partner KYC

MySQL 8.0+ Database Server

Redis Server (redis:8.0)
Port 6379 - Appendonly: yes

Node.js 22 Standalone Server (server.js)
Port 3000 - Non-Root user: nextjs
Healthcheck: fetch 127.0.0.1:3000

Reverse Proxy / SSL Ingress (Nginx / Traefik / Cloudflare)
TLS 1.3 Termination - Strict HTTP Security Headers
